text:
deploy-bot: Postdeploy check: release v1.15.1 -> prod-usw2 completed. Canary->staged. Rollout ID rl_c4d5.

nora: Noticing synth agent flapping on tekton-route: intermittent 502 returned by model-worker during heavy sample, p95 ~1.1s, p50 normal.

dev-rel: 502s are visible in our QA harness but only for requests > 512 tokens. Could be tokenizer change in v1.15.1.

ben: If tokenizer change, that implies compatibility mismatch for long prompts. Suggest we pin tekton-route to previous model for long-payloads only via route-split rule: if tokens>512 -> model=v1.14.8 else v1.15.1.

infra: We do have conditional routing support. We can add a temporary rule to reroute long payloads back to v1.14.8 via redwoodctl.

nora: Let's run the smoke for a long payload to validate:
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('x'*600)")
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/tekton-route/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

nora: Pre-rule smoke: TIME:2.2s STATUS:502

infra: I'll add conditional routing rule now:
```bash
redwoodctl route rule add --route tekton-route --match "len(tokens)>512" --model redwood-tekton-v1.14.8 --duration 60m --reason "postdeploy long-payload 502s"
```

deploy-bot: Rule applied: tekton-route long-payload rule -> redwood-tekton-v1.14.8 duration 60m by infra. Audit=aud_81f2.

dev-rel: Rerun smoke after rule:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/tekton-route/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

dev-rel: Post-rule smoke: TIME:0.58s STATUS:200

ben: That confirms tokenizer mismatch. Plan: leave rule for 60m while we debug model tokenizer drift and prepare a proper fix or minor model re-release. Add note to rollout: "temporary token-length rule for tekton-route due to 502s on >512 tokens".

sre-oncall: Make sure to watch error-rate on other routes. Pager threshold unchanged.

nora: I'll upload a sample failing request and the model input tokenization diff to the rollout artifacts for model team.

infra: Note: conditional rules auto-expire after 60m; extend if needed.

deploy-bot: Rollout artifacts: artifacts.redwood/rl_c4d5/ include smoke logs and rule audit.

ben: If tokenizer change intentional (breaking), we should document in release notes and call out migration advice. Otherwise rollback candidate.

nora: Will coordinate with model-ops. Closing thread after 45m unless further anomalies.
